question: A sector of a circle having a radius 14 cm has area 154 cm². Find the angle of the sector.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total area of the circle = πr² = (22/7) × 14 × 14 = 616 cm².

Sector area as a fraction of the total area = 154 / 616 = 1/4.

Angle of the sector = Fraction of area × 360°.

Angle = (1/4) × 360° = 90°.

**∴ The correct answer is 90°.**
